text:
anya: Quick FYI — quickstart README cURL example is breaking on Windows and causing onboarding friction. The example uses single quotes around headers and inline JSON; PowerShell chokes. Also the JS sample expects REDWOOD_API_KEY while the Go sample uses REDWOOD_KEY. Docs also say retries are handled automatically but Node SDK currently disables retries by default. We're getting support tickets for all three issues.

matt: Repro'd on Win 10/11 PowerShell. Minimal failing example:

```
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```

PowerShell treats single quotes differently -> you need double quotes or use --data-binary.

lia: Proposed docs patch: show both POSIX and PowerShell variants. Eg POSIX:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```

PowerShell:

```
$body = @{ input = 'hello' } | ConvertTo-Json
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -Headers @{ Authorization = \"Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY\" } -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json'
```

matt: Also found the Go sample uses `os.Getenv(\"REDWOOD_KEY\")` — inconsistent. I'll update the Go snippet to `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and leave a short note about the env var name in the migration/changelog.

sam: We should make SDK retry behavior explicit. Quickstart currently says \"retries handled by SDK\" which is ambiguous. Suggest adding a tiny table in troubleshooting: Node: retries off by default (show how to enable), Python: 3 retries by default, Go: 2 retries by default. Link to SDK config page.

anya: Agreed. Add a one-liner in troubleshooting and link to a new page \"SDK retry policies\". Also add a changelog entry for the env var alignment so users are aware.

devex-bot: Issue created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/2345 ; PR draft -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/123 (assigning @matt)

matt: I'll pick this up today and push the POSIX/PowerShell examples plus env var fix. Leaving notes in the PR. :thumbsup:

lia: Thanks — will update onboarding email templates to include the PowerShell snippet too. :eyes:
